about: Corrections to the mod families refresh derives from DE data (V4; rule in app/pipeline/build/families.py). `join` merges mods the data does not link, `split` takes mods out of their derived family. In game two mods clash when they share a hidden parent type (saved Mod/Compatibility, Mod Incompatibility); DE's export has no parent field, so families are derived and corrected here. Each entry: id, mods (uniqueNames), names, reason, source (arsenal check or saved wiki page), verified.

join.reason: cannot be equipped together (also joins their pistol/shotgun counterparts, which never meet across classes)
